facts.fact: The vendor advises keeping a plain text message within 160 characters, which it describes as the general limit, to achieve the highest deliverability.
facts.quote: A plain text message is generally limited to 160 characters. Although some carriers and phone instruments are able to work around that limitation, it is best to keep the message within that limit

facts.fact: The Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) governs the use of text messaging for marketing but does not apply to customer servicing messages, according to the page.
facts.quote: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) governs the use of text messaging for  marketing, but it does not apply to customers servicing messages

facts.fact: The page says some income tax clients come to prepare returns in late January or early February, while others wait until late March or early April.
facts.quote: Some clients come to you to prepare their income tax returns in late January or early February while some like to wait till late March or early April.
